_comment: Every change to the learning content, dated — including the ones that make us look bad. A lesson that was wrong is more useful to a learner as a published correction than as a quiet edit. Hand-maintained on purpose: git history records what changed, not why it mattered or who caught it. Newest first. 'kind' must be one of the values scripts/validate-content.mjs allows.

entries.what: Everyday Productivity published — eight lessons on where AI actually fits in your day, email, reading long documents, research that cites its sources, meeting notes, planning, a twenty-minute routine, and what not to hand over.
Reading preferences added: text size, line spacing, line length, contrast, a reading typeface and data saver. Dark mode also now follows your device — it had been built but never switched on.
Answer options are now shuffled. 94% of correct answers had been sitting in the middle slot, so always picking the middle passed every module quiz without reading the question.
Eight lessons on briefing, iteration, correcting a wrong answer, and the requests no wording can rescue. Adds a 22-question quiz bank and 24 review cards.
NotebookLM was renamed Gemini Notebook by Google in July. The lesson title and the tool card now say so, and the documentation link it pointed at had been dead for six weeks.
Claude's tool card claimed no voice support. Voice mode has shipped on every plan, so the capability grid was showing learners a wrong fact.
